defects.claim: holdsTypedArray spreads every array member into one push call, so a snapshot with a nodes array past the argument-count limit throws
defects.scenario: a raw or encoded snapshot with a nodes array past the engine's argument-count limit throws even though each node and the output rectangle are valid; a live scene takes the toJSON branch and avoids it
defects.cause: spread of unbounded array into push()

defects.claim: a second dispose call resolves immediately while the first is still closing the browser or context
defects.scenario: one owner starts disposal, another awaits dispose before releasing shared resources and gets an already-resolved promise while the host's browser is still closing
defects.cause: disposed flag set before close completes; no shared pending promise
